what: trụ lan can đường đi bộ Hạ Long, the panel of red brown granite in the parapet of the walk of Hạ Long
uses: Plan 0026: in the row of lan_can_ha_long, one in place of a piece about every 10 m (photo 1).

photos.author: Kwozyn
photos.shows: Two men sit on the parapet of the walk of the sea of Hạ Long at sunset, to the north-west: the parapet clad in smooth grey granite with a top slab and a panel of red brown granite, the walk of light tiles with dark square tiles, the boats of the bay, Núi Lớn.

photos.author: VnExpress
photos.shows: Hạ Long empty in the lockdown: the walk of the sea with a low parapet of light stone with dark red square pillars about every 10 m, lamp posts of four and five globes, benches, the road with a double yellow line.

checks: A block of red brown granite a little higher and deeper than the parapet.
